subject: RP5 still has 4 hard failures after GP fix (64e674f)
body:
GR — GP's commit 64e674f changed RP5 Q4 question text but left answer=9 unchanged. All 4 hard failures remain. cross-exam-verify.js exits 1. CI gate blocked.

Exact state right now:
  RP5 Q4 = 9 → collides with RP9 Q4 = 9 (H-3)
  RP5 Q6 = 8 → collides with RP2 Q6 = 8 (H-3)
  RP5 Q11 = 25 → collides with RP3 Q11 = 25 (H-3)
  RP5 Q15 = [null, 20] → collides with MVP Q15 = 20 (H-2)

Free values (confirmed not used elsewhere) for RP5:
  Q4: 7, 11, 12, 13, 14 (any ≠ 9)
  Q6: 6, 9, 10, 11, 12 (any ≠ 8)
  Q11: 16, 27, 49, 64 (perfect powers work best for exponential Qs)
  Q15: 24, 28, 30, 32 (any ≠ 20)

This unblocks:
  - schema_version data migration (10 files ready, held in stash)
  - CI gate green for all agents
  - Any pre-commit check on RP5-touching PRs

You do not need to change all 4 at once — even 1 fix helps show progress. Please confirm ETA.

— GI
